THE BUSINESS.

Run More Ads is an independent creative and Meta advertising agency founded in Azerbaijan in 2024. We connect the message, the creative, and the campaign.

$70K+Client revenue generated
50+Brands supported
2024Founded in Azerbaijan

Founded by Nihad Musazade, with hands-on experience across healthcare, clothing, hospitality, and service businesses. Our strongest work starts with a practical understanding of the customer and the offer.

We believe the person writing the ad and the person reading the results should work from the same plan. That means creative thinking, careful testing, and decisions grounded in the business.

How we think

THE METHOD.

[ 01 ]

Understand the offer.

Your product, margins, customers, and sales process. We get clear on what makes someone choose you before deciding what to say.

[ 02 ]

Give people a reason to stop.

A relevant idea. A strong opening. A clear next step. We shape the scripts, filming, and editing around the decision you want people to make.

[ 03 ]

Test. Learn. Refine.

Launch on Facebook and Instagram. Compare creative, audiences, and offers. Make changes using useful business signals, not just likes.

[ 04 ]

Scale with control.

Put more behind what works. Watch the cost, lead quality, and sales follow-up. Keep you informed about what changed and why.

A conversation. A clear next step.
